label: Corruption Perceptions Index (Transparency International)
source: Transparency International, Corruption Perceptions Index 2024 (via Our World in Data)
license: CC BY 4.0 (as listed by Our World in Data); Transparency International site: CC BY-ND 4.0
notes: Perceived public-sector corruption, 0 (very corrupt) to 100 (very clean): the simple average of up to 13 expert and business surveys, each rescaled to 0-100. It measures perceptions, not corruption directly. The method has been the same since 2012, so scores compare over time; earlier years are not comparable and are not published here. 2025 scores (released in 2026) are not in the Our World in Data copy yet. Country rows only. Published unchanged from the Our World in Data grapher CSV (retrieved 2026-10-05). Licence: Our World in Data lists CC BY 4.0; the Transparency International website states CC BY-ND 4.0 for its content, so scores are republished without alteration and with attribution.
